overallDisposition: Revision recommended. The 51 Reading items and five STAR items have clear best answers. The 用法 set needs attention, especially 見合わせる and 余裕, where distractors can be defended by alternate meanings or natural collocations.

items.reason: 見込む naturally expresses an expected future increase: the user count is projected to rise by about ten percent.
items.concern: The other options call for verbs such as 参照する, 踏まえる, or report an estimate rather than an actual result.

items.reason: 妥当だ is the natural predicate for a price judged reasonable after comparing estimates and effects.
items.concern: The distractors use 妥当 as a verb or bare noun where 妥当性 would be more idiomatic.

items.reason: 見合わせる naturally means suspending train service while safety is checked.
items.alternate: D can be read as comparing stakeholders’ views, a separate sense of 見合わせる, though 「意見を見合わせて」 is less idiomatic than 「意見を突き合わせて」.
items.concern: The item risks testing recognition of the suspension sense alone; replace D with a clearly incorrect use.

items.reason: 時間に余裕をもって is a natural expression for allowing sufficient time before the reception begins.
items.alternate: A uses 「予算に余裕が残っている」 naturally; D’s 「会場に十分な余裕がある」 can also be natural for spaciousness. Their surrounding statements create contradictions, so the item can be solved by logic rather than lexical use.
items.concern: This is the strongest issue in the packet: multiple distractors use 余裕 naturally, and B also makes 十分 ambiguous between “sufficient” and “ten minutes.”

items.reason: Reducing application fields naturally lightens the administrative burden on users.
items.concern: C’s 「荷物の負担」 is awkward and its causal link to lifting the load alone is unclear. D begins with a natural use of 負担 but ends with an incorrect particle pattern.

disagreementsAndUncertainties: N2_14_M1_30: D is plausible under the compare sense of 見合わせる, even though B is the canonical and most natural option in this context.
N2_14_M1_31: A and D contain natural collocations with 余裕; their contradictions make them poor lexical distractors.
N2_14_M1_32: C is a borderline physical-load interpretation of 負担, but the complete sentence is awkward and does not clearly express a coherent situation.
limitations: Review used only the learner-visible text and choices in the hash-verified packet. No answer key, source material, prior review, or native-speaker certification was used. This is an AI content review; subtle native-speaker judgments may differ.
